name: rig-anything
description: Analyse an arbitrary Blender mesh to work out how it should be rigged: whether automatic weights can bind to it at all, which way is up and forward, how many limbs touch the ground, and which skeleton archetype fits. Deterministic geometry measures, renders let vision classify, and a verification harness stops a silently-stale rig from producing confident but fictional measurements. Phases 0 and 1: it reports, it does not yet build skeletons or animation.
